projects.title: SamDrive (Patente B)
projects.tagline: Persian prep for the Italian driving theory exam
projects.text:
• A free platform for Persian speakers to prepare for the Italian driving theory exam (Patente B).
  • About 7,100 official questions with Persian translations, 400+ road signs and a saveable Italian to Persian vocabulary list.
  • Timed mock exams (30 questions in 20 minutes), progress tracking across 25 topics and an AI assistant that explains answers in simple Persian.

projects.title: Mood Pal
projects.tagline: Mood tracking and daily check-ins on Telegram
projects.text:
• A Telegram bot that helps people track their mood and understand their emotions.
  • Sends daily reminders to check in.
  • It also exposes each user's current mood as an animated sticker, the one you see next to my photo on this page.

projects.title: Italy Market
projects.tagline: Marketplace bot for the Iranian community in Italy
projects.text:
• I developed a Telegram bot platform
  • It used in the most popular channels for Iranian in Italy to exchange their goods and services.
  • I have developed a telegram bot to help them to find their needs easily.

projects.title: Italy Covid
projects.tagline: Daily COVID-19 case prediction for Italy
projects.text:
• I developed a covid case prediction for Italy that used time series online algorithms
  • I't predict daily covid cases in Italy with 5% error.
  • Source of data was from health ministery of Italy
